reviewed_gates: Pins bind exact runner, frozen CPU auditor, all auditor dependencies, numerical contract, completed producer and separate numerical admission. Launch admission binds exact plan/entry/contract and forbids device selection or extra argv.
Fresh runs/<name>/output is claimed once by exclusive directory creation. Existing failed/successful attempts cannot be retried through this runner.

Only frozen supervisor supervise/signal_guard/write functions are used. The module import does not execute its old NPU runner main; there is no device inspection, CANN shell, model construction or card-lock action.

Two-core affinity and backend-autoload0 environment apply before child creation. Fresh process-group supervision samples current summed group RSS every0.25s: train32GiB/dev4GiB,900s worker wall budget,30s TERM grace followed by owned KILL if necessary.
TERM/INT around process creation is blocked until process identity is assigned. Failure or remaining owned descendants prevents completion; only the owned fresh process group is cleaned.

Completion requires actual-array audit status and exact typed role/counts, CPU runtime, no backend/model invocation, unchanged producer-manifest identity and a bound small archive. Metadata-only complete cannot satisfy this gate.
Plan/runtime pins are rechecked after exit; a changed source or terminal/archive failure revokes acceptance. Head-training admission remains false.

test_evidence_scope.scope: Local stdlib mocked-supervisor fixtures; not a new Linux live-process resource-guard execution.

resource_boundary: 900seconds covers the worker including cache audit and its archive. Parent metadata preflight/postflight and fixed TERM/KILL cleanup are outside worker wall accounting.
RSS is a sampled owned-process-group sum, not a cgroup/kernel memory quota.
The referenced frozen supervisor source was inspected; this review does not independently repeat prior real Linux supervisor tests.
